scripts.dev: concurrently "pnpm --dir artifacts/api-server run dev" "pnpm --dir artifacts/dallyletter run dev"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.lint:release: pnpm exec prettier --check .github/workflows/*.yml render.yaml DEPLOYMENT.md INSTALL.md README.md RELEASE-WORKFLOW.md package.json
scripts.ci:verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm run lint:release
